operatorProperties.code:
def process(worldcities):
    import pandas as pd
    df = worldcities.copy()
    # Ensure population numeric; treat missing as NaN
    df['population'] = pd.to_numeric(df['population'], errors='coerce')
    # Exclude rows with missing or non-positive population (0 likely placeholder)
    df = df[df['population'].notna() & (df['population'] > 0)]
    out = (df.groupby('country', as_index=False)['population']
             .mean()
             .rename(columns={'population': 'avg_city_population'}))
    return out.sort_values('avg_city_population', ascending=False)
